M5 MicroLC: See More with Microflow LC-MS

The M5 MicroLC system is a feature-rich microflow LC-MS solution meant to simplify small and large molecule quantitation and characterization. Inject less of your precious sample, and take advantage of this extremely sensitive, versatile instrument. The M5 MicroLC system helps you save on costs, is eco-friendly with low solvent consumption and low-waste output, and can be integrated with Analyst and SCIEX OS software.

The M5 MicroLC system is the perfect balance of sensitivity and robustness—more sensitive than traditional analytical flow LC, and more flexible and more robust than nanoflow LC — giving you the potential to optimize your critical workflows, today and into the future.
Status: Discontinued, fully supported Require more information? Learn more
The M5 MicroLC system is engineered to give you maximum performance, flexibility and robustness for your workflow of choice. See how we can put the M5 MicroLC to work for you.
Experience greater sensitivity, flexibility, and robustness with the advanced technology in the M5 MicroLC system.

The adoption of LC-MS system is becoming more desirable in today’s laboratories due to its high selectivity, accuracy, and precision for analyzing bioanalysis candidates. The M5 MicroLC system offers a complete solution to optimize your biologic workflows, today and into the future.
Pair your M5 MicroLC system with specially designed columns and industry-leading mass spectrometers for maximum sensitivity for your most challenging applications.
